name: VEAI
description: Your living intelligence remembers everything, sees what you see, figures out your goals, and doesn’t stop until they're done.
author: Ve AI

scripts.postinstall: electron-builder install-app-deps && npm run rebuild:native:mac && npm run clean:sharp && npm run setup:hey-ve
scripts.clean:sharp: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const nodeModulesPath = path.join(__dirname, 'node_modules', '@img'); console.log('🔧 Ensuring Sharp package structure for all platforms...'); if (fs.existsSync(nodeModulesPath)) { const requiredDirs = ['sharp-darwin-arm64', 'sharp-darwin-x64', 'sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64', 'sharp-libvips-darwin-x64', 'sharp-linux-arm', 'sharp-linux-arm64', 'sharp-linux-x64', 'sharp-libvips-linux-arm', 'sharp-libvips-linux-arm64', 'sharp-libvips-linux-x64', 'sharp-win32-ia32', 'sharp-win32-x64', 'sharp-libvips-win32-ia32', 'sharp-libvips-win32-x64']; requiredDirs.forEach(dir => { const dirPath = path.join(nodeModulesPath, dir); if (!fs.existsSync(dirPath)) { fs.mkdirSync(dirPath, { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dirPath, '.gitkeep'), ''); console.log('✅ Created missing directory:', dir); } else { console.log('✅ Directory exists:', dir); } }); console.log('🎉 All Sharp directories ensured for cross-platform builds'); } else { console.log('📁 @img directory not found'); }"
scripts.install-python-deps: cd electron/wakeWord && (python -m pip install -r requirements.txt || python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt || py -m pip install -r requirements.txt)
scripts.dev: npm run build:boring-notch:clean:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_ELECTRON_SHOW_DYNAMIC_ISLAND=false npm run clean:build:dev && vite -- --js-flags="--expose-gc --max-old-space-size=4096 --optimize-for-size"
scripts.dev:full: npm run build:boring-notch:clean && npm run dev
scripts.dev:with-boring-notch: npm run build:boring-notch:clean && npm run dev
scripts.dev:mac:entitled: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native:mac && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 -c.mac.identity=null && open "dist/mac-arm64/Ve AI.app"
scripts.dev:win: set NODE_ENV=development && npm run clean:build:win && vite
scripts.build: npm run build:boring-notch:clean:prod && npm run bundle:python-runtime && cross-env NODE_ENV=production VITE_ELECTRON_SHOW_DYNAMIC_ISLAND=false node --max-old-space-size=12288 --expose-gc --optimize-for-size node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --mode production
scripts.build:win: npm run build:boring-notch:clean && npm run bundle:python-runtime && set NODE_ENV=production && set VITE_ELECTRON_SHOW_DYNAMIC_ISLAND=false && node --max-old-space-size=12288 node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --mode production
scripts.package: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.package:all: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build && electron-builder -mw
scripts.build:analyze: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build && npx vite-bundle-analyzer build
scripts.package:mac: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build && electron-builder --mac -- --js-flags="--expose-gc"
scripts.build:boring-notch:clean: cd boring.notch && rm -rf build && rm -rf DerivedData && node ../scripts/build-boring-notch.js
scripts.build:boring-notch:clean:dev: cd boring.notch && rm -rf build && rm -rf DerivedData && BUILD_MODE=development node ../scripts/build-boring-notch.js
scripts.build:boring-notch:clean:prod: cd boring.notch && rm -rf build && rm -rf DerivedData && BUILD_MODE=production node ../scripts/build-boring-notch.js
scripts.package:mac:app:unsigned: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build:boring-notch:clean && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.package:mac:app:unsigned:both: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build:boring-notch:clean && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir -a x64,arm64 -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.package:linux: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.publish:mac: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish=always
scripts.publish:win: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish=always
scripts.publish:linux: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish=always
scripts.publish:all: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --win --linux --publish=always
scripts.test:dmg: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build:boring-notch:clean && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native:mac && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false -c.mac.artifactName='Ve.AI-Test-${arch}.${ext}' -c.directories.output='dist/test'
scripts.dmg:test: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build:boring-notch:clean && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native:mac && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false -c.mac.artifactName='Ve.AI-Test.${ext}' -c.directories.output='dist'
scripts.clean:build: rm -rf dist-electron && rm -rf build && rm -rf dist
scripts.clean:build:win: if exist dist-electron rmdir /s /q dist-electron && if exist build rmdir /s /q build && if exist dist rmdir /s /q dist
scripts.release:dmg: npm run clean:build:cross && npm run build:boring-notch:clean && npm run build && npm run rebuild:native:mac && electron-builder --mac --publish always

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Please give us access to your microphone
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Please give us access to your camera
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: We need permission to capture your screen so you can ask AI questions about what you see.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Ve AI needs access to your calendar to show upcoming events in the notch area, helping you stay organized while you work.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Ve AI needs to control other apps (Spotify/Safari) to read now playing info for media controls.
extendInfo.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: Ve AI uses Accessibility permissions to detect selected text and display the Selection Assistant popup. Your selections stay encrypted on this device.
